name: room-office: the front office of Knightsbrook, four walls, Sunburst, for the second test room "Back in Five Minutes" (levels/LEVEL-eval2.md)
notes: Walls drawn before Gate C under playbook 4ac: only once the owner has agreed the cost and accepted that a puzzle change can send them back. The anchor is the entrance wall (o3), the busiest; the head's-door wall (o2) and the cupboard wall (o4) follow with the anchor attached; the counter wall (o1) last with all three.

Two things this room tests that the method has not drawn: a grey rainy daylight from a window beside a doorway (the classroom and the kitchen had sun), and a carpeted floor. The moving things are left off the walls per the room file (the counter-top things, the gecko, the palm); the drawer front, the handset, the cupboard door and the copier lid are painted in and lifted by crop (playbook 4r).
The real charge lands in results and goes in the level file's ledger.
